steps.title: Who is visiting?
steps.detail: Record the visitor's name and where they have come from.

steps.title: Has the visitor been on another livestock farm this week?
steps.detail: Ask before the visitor enters. Answer Yes if they have been near other goats, sheep or cattle in the last seven days.

steps.title: Disinfect the visitor's footwear
steps.detail: Walk the visitor through the footbath and record one video of both boots being dipped.

steps.title: Issue farm overshoes
steps.detail: Hand the visitor a pair of farm overshoes and confirm they are wearing them.

steps.title: Log the visit at the gate
steps.detail: Enter the visitor in the gate register with the time in and the pens they will see.
